periods.time: Night before the joint training camp ends

name.zh: 加加美发现晓学园并遭艾莉丝刺击
name.en: Kagami uncovers Akatsuki and Alice stabs her

periods.summary: Prompted by Ikki's concern about Amane, Kagami investigates Amane's strange records and the broader pattern of unknown first-year representatives. She realizes there is effectively an eighth school hidden among the seven academies and compiles a list of likely Akatsuki infiltrators. Alice, revealed as one of them, emerges from the shadows and stabs her with Darkness Hermit in Fantasy Form before hiding her and the documents.
periods.cause: Kagami notices Amane's six wins by no contest and traces common irregularities among the representatives.
periods.outcome: Kagami is rendered unconscious and kidnapped; Alice reports the discovery to Reisen and continues preparing the pre-festival attack.
periods.significance: First explicit discovery of Akatsuki's hidden-school scheme and first present-day proof of Alice's infiltration.
